title: TCI Configuration
description: Configuration for TCI accounts and payment cards.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: TCI accounts indexed by telephone number or subscription identifier.

cards.title: Payment Cards
cards.description: Payment cards indexed by user-defined identifiers.

account.title: Account
account.description: TCI account credentials and payment preferences.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password used to authenticate with the TCI customer portal.

payment_card.title: Payment Card
payment_card.description: Identifier of a card in the top-level cards object.

payment_card.title: Payment Card
payment_card.description: Bank card credentials used by the TCI payment gateway.

number.title: Card Number
number.description: 16-digit bank card number (PAN), stored as a string.

cvv2.title: CVV2
cvv2.description: Card verification code, usually 3 or 4 digits.

expiry.title: Expiration Date
expiry.description: Expiration date in the Iranian Solar Hijri calendar, formatted as YYYY/MM.

second_password.title: Static Second Password
second_password.description: Static online payment password (رمز دوم ثابت), not a dynamic one-time password (رمز پویا).
